name: RG202618
tagline: Efficient secondary combustion for a clean, low-smoke outdoor experience
description: The HGD 20-inch Smokeless Fire Pit is a contemporary outdoor heating solution crafted from durable 304 stainless steel. It utilizes a sophisticated double-wall construction and 360° airflow technology to facilitate secondary combustion, which significantly reduces smoke and ash. Its sleek, polished silver finish and compact, portable design—complete with a removable ash pan for easy cleaning—make it an ideal centerpiece for backyard gatherings, camping trips, or patio relaxation.
features: Double-wall structure for low-smoke secondary combustion
Removable integrated ash pan and burning plate for easy maintenance
High-grade 304 stainless steel construction for rust resistance
Sturdy support legs for heat protection on various surfaces
Portable design includes a dedicated carrying bag
